results.notes: IPv4 loopback echo, one persistent connection and two threads. Setup/affinity/warmup/byte validation outside sample bracket. CPU cores = process CPU / measured-loop wall (includes validation), can exceed 1. RTT includes both directions and scheduling; no NIC/wire inference. Closed-loop successful RTT only; timeouts excluded from RTT percentiles and counted separately. --batch unused. TCP peer reads entire window then echoes it; unbatched sends each message, batched sends contiguous window. Blocking socket timeouts track remaining operation deadline rounded up to ms; kernel/scheduler can delay wakeup.
